svg.title: Enterprise hospital system cloud and DevSecOps blueprint
svg.desc: GitHub repositories trigger a two-stage GitHub Actions pipeline that pushes images to ECR and deploys to AWS. Patients reach CloudFront, which routes to an ALB, a Fargate tier and a multi-AZ RDS tier inside a 3-tier VPC. CloudWatch collects telemetry, and architects monitor it and manage Terraform state.
svg.text: Enterprise hospital system: cloud and DevSecOps blueprint
Decoupled CI/CD, OIDC federation, CloudFront, 3-tier VPC, Fargate, multi-AZ RDS
